lines.text: A man in the crowd asks Jesus to tell his brother to divide the inheritance, but Jesus refuses to be judge.
Jesus warns them to guard against every form of pride, since life does not consist in abundant possessions.
A rich man's ground produces an abundance, and he has nowhere to store his crops.
He plans to tear down his barns and build bigger ones, then tell himself to take it easy.
God calls him a fool and says his grain will be taken by thieves that very night.

wrong_details.wrong: his grain will be taken by thieves
